hook.en: You benched the hockey captain in the final. Now he's cornered you in the tunnel - and wants his medic to clear him for one drink.
hook.zh: 决赛里你把冰球队长按上了替补席。现在他把你堵在通道里——要他的队医批准他去喝一杯。

options.en: Sign his clearance - and write your number under it.
options.zh: 签字放行——再把电话号码写在下面

options.en: Click the penlight on: 'Follow the light first, captain.'
options.zh: 打开笔灯：“先跟着光走一遍，队长。”

options.en: Take the clipboard back and walk past him to the exit.
options.zh: 拿回夹板，从他身边走向出口

caps.en: You benched me in the third period.
caps.zh: 第三节你把我按在了替补席上。

caps.en: Ask me anything. Name. Date... your number.
caps.zh: 随便问。名字。日期……你的电话。

caps.en: Your pulse is faster than mine, doc.
caps.zh: 你的心跳比我还快，医生。

caps.en: Team's at the bar. I'm not going.
caps.zh: 队友都去酒吧了。我不去。

caps.en: Unless my medic clears me... for one drink.
caps.zh: 除非我的队医批准我……喝一杯。
